provenance.card_label_resources: HCEffectName_0/HCEffectName_1 and func_0809DE30 consume battle-label gfx, index and duration fields. The physical label span contains 55 native records and ends at the separately rooted SpriteFrameResourceDef array. CardDef labels 0..53 are established; placeholder rows also carry 140..144, so no proof of universally safe indexing or invented larger array is claimed. Public externs remain unsized. The 106 SpriteFrameResourceDef records are bounded independently by the named Mode_Deck string, recipe IDs through 105 from func_080AC5E8/func_080AD144, the <=105 task-creation guard, and status frame consumers. Each of the 161 selected sprite indices is checked against its already owned native graphics array, including all five EU language choices. US/JP raw tile mappings are exact one-to-one pairs proven by the entire corresponding record-group partition, with native indices and sizes preserved rather than asserting identical localized payloads. EU pointers instead refer the existing mode_test_data five-language wrappers. US/JP label word unk_04 is a consistent native scalar, 24704/28032 respectively. EU omits that word, changes two duration values and one recipe sprite index, and uses actual language-wrapper pointer types.

provenance.native_catalog: The existing generated catalog is retained as one source-level data owner. Ordinary initialized definitions emit its complete original contiguous data run in source order in all three regions. This reconstruction treats the homogeneous catalog as a legitimate data-only translation unit; no stronger claim about original filenames is made. Every object address, physical extent, initializer and relocation target is preserved; no padding, qualification or regional-bound changes are introduced.
